text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Jalan-Jalan Persekutuan

(Pengurusan Persendirian) (Pungutan Tol) (Lebuh Raya Kajang-Seremban)

(Pindaan) (No. 2) 2022.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 1 Januari 2023.

Pindaan perenggan 2

2. Perintah Jalan-Jalan Persekutuan (Pengurusan Persendirian) (Pungutan Tol)

(Lebuh Raya Kajang-Seremban) 2016 [P.U. (A) 264/2016], yang disebut

"Perintah ibu" dalam Perintah ini, dipinda dalam subperenggan 2(1) dengan

menggantikan perkataan "7 Mei 2039" dengan perkataan "8 Mei 2064".

KELAS KENDERAAN

Kelas 1: Kenderaan yang mempunyai dua gandar dan tiga atau empat roda

(tidak termasuk teksi dan bas)

Kelas 2: Kenderaan yang mempunyai dua gandar dan lima atau enam roda

(tidak termasuk bas)

Kelas 3: Kenderaan yang mempunyai tiga gandar atau lebih (tidak termasuk bas)

Kelas 4: Teksi

Kelas 5: Bas

Bagi maksud mengira bilangan gandar dan roda sesebuah kenderaan, gandar dan roda

mana-mana treler yang ditarik oleh kenderaan itu hendaklah dikira sebagai sebahagian

daripada gandar dan roda kenderaan itu.".

FEDERAL ROADS (PRIVATE MANAGEMENT) ACT 1984

FEDERAL ROADS (PRIVATE MANAGEMENT) (COLLECTION OF TOLLS)

(KAJANG-SEREMBAN HIGHWAY) (AMENDMENT) (NO.2) ORDER 2022

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 2 of the

Federal Roads (Private Management) Act 1984 [Act 306], the Minister makes

the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Federal Roads (Private Management)

(Collection of Tolls) (Kajang-Seremban Highway) (Amendment) (No. 2)

Order 2022.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 1 January 2023.

Amendment of paragraph 2

2. The Federal Roads (Private Management) (Collection of Tolls)

(Kajang-Seremban Highway) Order 2016 [P.U. (A) 264/2016], which is referred to as the

"principal Order" in this Order, is amended in subparagraph 2(1) by substituting for the

words "7 May 2039" the words "8 May 2064".

Substitution of First Schedule

the following schedules:

CLASS OF VEHICLES

Class 1: Vehicles having two axles and three or four wheels (excluding taxis

and buses)

Class 2: Vehicles having two axles and five or six wheels (excluding buses)

Class 3: Vehicles having three axles or more (excluding buses)

Class 4: Taxis

Class 5: Buses

For the purpose of calculating the number of axles and wheels of a vehicle,

the axles and wheels of any trailer towed by the vehicle shall be calculated as part of the

axles and wheels of the vehicle.".
